name: lane-fence
description: Keeps a read-only subagent's Bash writes inside its record paths, judged where each write truly lands

agentTypes.title: Fenced agent types
agentTypes.description: Comma-separated subagent types whose Bash writes are fenced. Empty fences none. Every other agent, and the main loop, writes anywhere.

recordFolders.title: Record folders
recordFolders.description: Comma-separated folder patterns under the session root a fenced agent may write in. A * matches one or more characters inside one path segment.

memoryRoot.title: Agent memory root
memoryRoot.description: Folder under the session root holding one memory folder per agent type; each fenced agent may write only its own. Empty turns this record path off.

worktreesDir.title: Worktrees folder
worktreesDir.description: Folder under the session root holding the repo's own worktrees; a record path inside one of them counts too. Empty anchors at the session root alone.

rootTmp.title: Session tmp folder
rootTmp.description: Scratch folder under the session root a fenced agent may write in. Empty turns it off.

systemTmp.title: System tmp folder
systemTmp.description: Absolute scratch folder a fenced agent may write in. Empty turns it off.

statDeadlineMs.title: Stat deadline in ms
statDeadlineMs.description: The longest the fence waits on the file system while placing one call's writes; a stat past it is refused and the write denied.
